INSPECTION PROCEDURE
HINT:
Start the inspection from step 1 in case of using the TOYOTA hand-held tester and start from step 2 in case
of not uslna the TOYOTA hand-held tester.
1 Check ABS solenoid relay operation.
PREPARATION:
(a) Connect the TOYOTA hand-held tester to the DLC3.
(b) Tum the ignition switch ON and push the TOYOTA hand-held tester main switch ON.
(c) Select the ACTIVE TEST mode on the TOYOTA hand-held tester.
CHECK:
Check the operation sound of the ABS solenoid relay when operating it with lhe TOYOTA hand-held tester.
OK:
The operation sound of the ABS solenoid relay should be heard.

2 Check voltage between terminal 5 of engine room RIB No. 1 (for ABS solenoid
relay) and body groud.
PREPARATION:
Remove the ABS solenoid relay from engine room RIB No. 1.
CHECK:
Measure the voltage between terminal 5 of engine room RIB
No. 1 (for ABS solenoid relay) and body ground.
OK:
Voltage: 10-14 V
